---
title: "07 - Chapman-Richards growth curve fits"
output: html_document
---

**Purpose.** Fit Chapman-Richards (C-R) growth curves of carbon vs. stand age, `C = a * (1 - exp(-b * age))^c`, for AGC stocks and for the SOC difference between agroforestry and control plots (ΔSOC), by climate region (ecoregion) x agroforestry category. It reports stock at maturity, age at maturity, and growth rate with bootstrap confidence intervals.

**Model.** The model is reparameterised for fitting: `a = y_ref * plogis(alpha)`, where `y_ref` is the 0.95 quantile of the response in the partition, and `b` is derived from `t95`, the age at which 95% of `a` is reached (bounded to 5-80 years), with `c` bounded to 1.5-3. Fits use a brute-force start-value search (`nls2`) followed by bounded Levenberg-Marquardt (`minpack.lm::nlsLM`). Partitions with n < 15, failed fits, or negative R² are flagged in the `Reason` column and dropped from the filtered tables. Stock at maturity is the asymptote `a`. Age at maturity is the age at which 90% of `a` is reached (`t90 = -log(1 - 0.9^(1/c)) / b`). Growth rate is the mean annual increment to that age (`0.9 * a / t90`). 95% CIs for `a` and growth rate come from a case bootstrap (B = 300). Ecoregion panel figures show curve confidence bands from the delta method and, as an alternative, from a case bootstrap (B = 500). AGC fits (tables and figures) are weighted by stand age; SOC fits are unweighted. Random seeds are set at the start of each bootstrap chunk so results are reproducible.

**Inputs.**

- `output/data/{agc,agc_change,bgc,bgc_change,soc,soc_change}_by_plot_and_age_w_covars_drop_outliers.xlsx` (notebook 04). `agc` and `soc` are used for the curve fits; `agc_change` and `soc_change` give the observed mean annual change rate columns in the fit tables.

**Outputs.**

- `output/tables/agc_cr_fit_table.xlsx`, `output/tables/agc_cr_fit_table_filtered.xlsx` (the filtered table is used by notebooks 08 and 10). Fit tables have two header rows (curve-fit vs. observed annual change rate column groups), so read them with `startRow = 2`.
- `output/tables/soc_cr_fit_table.xlsx`, `output/tables/soc_cr_fit_table_filtered.xlsx`
- `output/figures/agc_cr_fit_by_af_cat_all_reg_panel.png`, `agc_cr_fit_by_er_all_af_cat_panel.png`, `agc_cr_fit_by_er_all_af_cat_panel_boot.png`
- `output/figures/soc_delta_cr_fit_by_af_cat_all_reg_panel.png`, `soc_delta_cr_fit_by_er_all_af_cat_panel.png`, `soc_delta_cr_fit_by_er_all_af_cat_panel_boot.png`

Analysis options: AF categories to fit and carbon pool labels.
```{r options}
af_cats <- c('AC', 'BP', 'COP', 'FAL', 'FOD', 'MS', 'PAR', 'ROT', 'SA', 'SP', 'SPC', 'TMC', 'WL', 'ALL')

c_data_names <- c('agc', 'bgc', 'soc', 'agc_change', 'bgc_change', 'soc_change')
c_data_labels <- c('agc' = "AGC", 'bgc' = "BGC", 'soc' = "SOC", 'agc_change' = "AGC change", 'bgc_change' = "BGC change", 'soc_change' = "SOC change")
dep_var_labels <- c('c_t_ha' = 'C stock (t/Ha)', 'c_t_ha_yr' = 'C change (t/Ha/yr)')
```

Helper: case-bootstrap 95% CI for the C-R parameter `a` (stock at maturity) and
the "growth rate" metric (mean annual increment to 90% of maturity). Re-used
by every region x af_cat fit in the loops below. Uses the already-fitted
model's coefficients as a warm start (no brute-force search per replicate),
so it is much cheaper than the full-curve bootstrap used for the ecoregion panel plots.
```{r cr-param-ci}
fit_cr_param_ci <- function(my_df, dep_var, warm_start, weight_var = NULL,
                             B = 300, alpha_level = 0.05,
                             t95_lower = 5, t95_upper = 80) {

  cr_form <- as.formula(paste0(
    dep_var, " ~ (y_ref * plogis(alpha)) *",
    " (1 - exp(-(-log(1 - 0.95^(1/c)) / t95) * age))^c"
  ))

  age_at_frac_ci <- function(frac, b, c) -log(1 - frac^(1 / c)) / b
  mai_to_frac_ci <- function(frac, a, b, c) {
    t_x <- age_at_frac_ci(frac, b, c)
    (frac * a) / t_x
  }

  a_boot      <- rep(NA_real_, B)
  growth_boot <- rep(NA_real_, B)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    resamp <- my_df[sample(nrow(my_df), nrow(my_df), replace = TRUE), ]
    y_ref  <- as.numeric(quantile(resamp[[dep_var]], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE))
    w      <- if (!is.null(weight_var)) resamp[[weight_var]] else rep(1, nrow(resamp))

    fit_b <- try(nlsLM(cr_form, data = resamp, start = warm_start,
      weights = w,
      lower = c(alpha = -20, t95 = t95_lower, c = 1.5),
      upper = c(alpha =  20, t95 = t95_upper, c = 3),
      control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 200, ftol = 1e-7, ptol = 1e-7)),
      silent = TRUE)

    if (inherits(fit_b, "try-error")) next

    co_b <- coef(fit_b)
    a_b  <- y_ref * plogis(co_b[["alpha"]])
    b_b  <- -log(1 - 0.95^(1 / co_b[["c"]])) / co_b[["t95"]]
    c_b  <- co_b[["c"]]

    a_boot[b]      <- a_b
    growth_boot[b] <- tryCatch(mai_to_frac_ci(0.9, a_b, b_b, c_b), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  }

  ok    <- !is.na(a_boot) & !is.na(growth_boot)
  n_ok  <- sum(ok)

  if (n_ok < B * 0.5) {
    return(list(a_lwr = NA_real_, a_upr = NA_real_,
                growth_lwr = NA_real_, growth_upr = NA_real_, n_ok = n_ok))
  }

  list(
    a_lwr      = as.numeric(quantile(a_boot[ok], alpha_level / 2)),
    a_upr      = as.numeric(quantile(a_boot[ok], 1 - alpha_level / 2)),
    growth_lwr = as.numeric(quantile(growth_boot[ok], alpha_level / 2)),
    growth_upr = as.numeric(quantile(growth_boot[ok], 1 - alpha_level / 2)),
    n_ok       = n_ok
  )
}
```


Fit C-R curves of AGC stock vs. age for each ecoregion x AF category combination (asymptote reference = 0.95 quantile of values in the partition; age-weighted fits), with bootstrap CIs for `a` and growth rate.
```{r agc-fits, fig.width=7, fig.height=7}
set.seed(4817)
c_data_name <- 'agc'
dep_var_name <- 'c_t_ha'
cont_var <- "age"

audebert_regs <- get(paste0(c_data_name, '_df')) %>%
  pull(ecoregion) %>% unique()
audebert_regs <- audebert_regs[!is.na(audebert_regs)]
audebert_regs <- c(audebert_regs, "ALL", "Tropical/subtropical all", "Temperate all")

# Map combined region labels to the underlying ecoregion values
combined_regs <- list(
  "Tropical/subtropical all" = c("Tropical/subtropical wet", "Tropical/subtropical dry"),
  "Temperate all"            = c("Temperate wet", "Temperate dry")
)

global_age_max <- get(paste0(c_data_name, '_df')) %>%
  pull(.data[[cont_var]]) %>% max(na.rm = TRUE)

agc_plot_list <- list()
agc_out_df <- tibble()

for (my_audebert_reg in audebert_regs) {
  for (my_af_cat in af_cats) {
    
    my_comb_lab <- paste0(my_audebert_reg, '; ', my_af_cat)
    message(my_comb_lab)
    
    # For combined regions, expand to constituent region values
    reg_vals <- if (!is.null(combined_regs[[my_audebert_reg]])) combined_regs[[my_audebert_reg]] else my_audebert_reg
    
    if (my_audebert_reg == 'ALL' && my_af_cat == 'ALL') {
      my_c_df <- get(paste0(c_data_name, '_df')) %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[dep_var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[cont_var]]))
    } else if (my_audebert_reg == 'ALL') {
      my_c_df <- get(paste0(c_data_name, '_df')) %>%
        filter(af_cat == my_af_cat) %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[dep_var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[cont_var]]))
    } else if (my_af_cat == 'ALL') {
      my_c_df <- get(paste0(c_data_name, '_df')) %>%
        filter(ecoregion %in% reg_vals) %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[dep_var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[cont_var]]))
    } else {
      my_c_df <- get(paste0(c_data_name, '_df')) %>%
        filter(ecoregion %in% reg_vals) %>%
        filter(af_cat == my_af_cat) %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[dep_var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[cont_var]]))
    }
    
    my_n <- nrow(my_c_df)
    
    insuff_dat <- FALSE
    if (my_n < 15) insuff_dat <- TRUE
    
    no_data_reason <- NA_character_
    if (insuff_dat) no_data_reason <- "Insufficient data"
    
    fit_ok <- FALSE
    
    if (!insuff_dat) {
      
      # asymptote cap at 0.95 quantile; weights by age prioritise mature systems
      q_cap <- 0.95
      y_max_obs <- max(my_c_df[[dep_var_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
      y_q <- quantile(my_c_df[[dep_var_name]], q_cap, na.rm = TRUE)
      y_ref <- as.numeric(y_q)
      
      # starting values based on capped reference
      a_start <- y_q
      a_frac_start <- min(max(as.numeric(a_start / y_ref), 1e-6), 0.99)
      alpha_start <- qlogis(a_frac_start)
      
      my_age_max <- max(my_c_df$age, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      t95_lower <- 5
      t95_upper <- 80
      
      c_start <- 2
      b_start <- 1 / max(median(my_c_df$age, na.rm = TRUE), 1e-6)
      t95_start <- -log(1 - 0.95^(1 / c_start)) / max(b_start, 1e-8)
      
      t95_grid <- seq(t95_lower, t95_upper, length.out = 7)
      
      start_grid <- expand.grid(
        alpha = seq(qlogis(0.005), qlogis(0.995), length.out = 15),
        t95   = t95_grid,
        c     = seq(1.5, 3, length.out = 5)
      )
      
      cr_nls2 <- try(
        nls2(
          c_t_ha ~ (y_ref * plogis(alpha)) *
            (1 - exp(-(-log(1 - 0.95^(1/c)) / t95) * age))^c,
          data = my_c_df,
          start = start_grid,
          weights = my_c_df[[cont_var]],
          algorithm = "brute-force",
          control = nls.control(maxiter = 50, warnOnly = TRUE)
        ),
        silent = TRUE
      )
      
      best_start <- if (!inherits(cr_nls2, "try-error")) {
        as.list(coef(cr_nls2))
      } else {
        list(alpha = alpha_start, t95 = t95_start, c = c_start)
      }
      
      cr_fit <- try(
        nlsLM(
          c_t_ha ~ (y_ref * plogis(alpha)) *
            (1 - exp(-(-log(1 - 0.95^(1/c)) / t95) * age))^c,
          data = my_c_df,
          start = best_start,
          weights = my_c_df[[cont_var]],
          lower = c(alpha = -20, t95 = t95_lower, c = 1.5),
          upper = c(alpha =  20, t95 = t95_upper, c = 3),
          control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 500, ftol = 1e-10, ptol = 1e-10)
        ),
        silent = TRUE
      )
      
      if (!inherits(cr_fit, "try-error")) {
        fit_ok <- TRUE
      } else {
        message("fit failed: ", attr(cr_fit, "condition")$message)
        no_data_reason <- "Fit failed"
      }
    }
    
    if (fit_ok) {
      
      b_from_t95 <- function(t95, c) {
        -log(1 - 0.95^(1 / c)) / t95
      }
      
      co <- coef(cr_fit)
      a_hat <- y_ref * plogis(co["alpha"])
      b_hat <- b_from_t95(co["t95"], co["c"])
      c_hat <- co["c"]
      
      age_grid <- tibble(!!cont_var := 0:global_age_max) %>%
        mutate(chapman_curve = as.numeric(predict(cr_fit, newdata = .)))
      
      ageinfl <- (1 / b_hat) * log(c_hat)
      
      age_at_frac <- function(frac, a, b, c) {
        -log(1 - frac^(1 / c)) / b
      }
      
      mai_to_frac <- function(frac, a, b, c) {
        t_x <- age_at_frac(frac, a, b, c)
        (frac * a) / t_x
      }
      
      t90 <- age_at_frac(0.9, a_hat, b_hat, c_hat)
      mai90 <- mai_to_frac(0.9, a_hat, b_hat, c_hat)
      
      rmse <- sqrt(mean((my_c_df[[dep_var_name]] - predict(cr_fit))^2))
      mae <- mean(abs(my_c_df[[dep_var_name]] - predict(cr_fit)))
      ss_res <- sum((my_c_df[[dep_var_name]] - predict(cr_fit))^2)
      ss_tot <- sum((my_c_df[[dep_var_name]] - mean(my_c_df[[dep_var_name]]))^2)
      r_squared <- 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
      
      if (r_squared < 0) {
        fit_ok <- FALSE
        no_data_reason <- "Negative R\u00b2"
        a_hat <- NA; b_hat <- NA; c_hat <- NA
        ageinfl <- NA; t90 <- NA; mai90 <- NA
        rmse <- NA; mae <- NA; r_squared <- NA
      }
      
    } else {
      a_hat <- NA; b_hat <- NA; c_hat <- NA
      ageinfl <- NA; t90 <- NA; mai90 <- NA
      rmse <- NA; mae <- NA; r_squared <- NA
    }
    
    # Bootstrap 95% CI for a (stock at maturity) and growth rate (MAI to 90% maturity)
    if (fit_ok) {
      ci_res <- fit_cr_param_ci(
        my_df = my_c_df, dep_var = dep_var_name,
        warm_start = as.list(coef(cr_fit)), weight_var = cont_var, B = 300
      )
      a_ci_lwr <- ci_res$a_lwr;        a_ci_upr <- ci_res$a_upr
      growth_ci_lwr <- ci_res$growth_lwr; growth_ci_upr <- ci_res$growth_upr
      boot_n_ok <- ci_res$n_ok
    } else {
      a_ci_lwr <- NA; a_ci_upr <- NA
      growth_ci_lwr <- NA; growth_ci_upr <- NA
      boot_n_ok <- NA
    }
    
    plot_obj <- ggplot(my_c_df, aes(x = !!sym(cont_var), y = !!sym(dep_var_name))) +
      geom_point(size = .5, alpha = .75, fill = 'black', stroke = 0) +
      { if (fit_ok) geom_line(data = age_grid, aes(y = chapman_curve),
                              color = "deepskyblue4", linewidth = .75) } +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 140), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
      xlim(0, 100) + # setting age limit for plot to 100y for better viz, even though there are a few outliers.  
      labs(title = my_af_cat, x = "Age", y = expression(AGC~(Mg~ha^{-1}))) +
      { if (!fit_ok) labs(title = paste0(my_af_cat, ' (', no_data_reason, ')')) } +
      { if (fit_ok) annotate("label", x = 99, y = 130,
          label = paste0("a = ", round(a_hat, 2), "\nb = ", round(b_hat, 4), "\nc = ", round(c_hat, 2),
                         "\nRMSE = ", round(rmse, 2), "\nR\u00b2 = ", round(r_squared, 2)),
          hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 2.5,
          fill = alpha("white", 0.8), label.size = 0,
          label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines")) } +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
    
    agc_plot_list[[my_audebert_reg]][[my_af_cat]] <- plot_obj
    
    agc_out_df <- agc_out_df %>% bind_rows(tibble(
      ecoregion = my_audebert_reg,
      af_cat = my_af_cat,
      n = my_n,
      asymptotic_max_a = a_hat,
      a_ci_lwr = a_ci_lwr,
      a_ci_upr = a_ci_upr,
      growth_rate_b = b_hat,
      curve_shape_c = c_hat,
      age_max_growth = ageinfl,
      age_90_pct = t90,
      avg_growth_rate_to_90 = mai90,
      growth_rate_ci_lwr = growth_ci_lwr,
      growth_rate_ci_upr = growth_ci_upr,
      boot_n_ok = boot_n_ok,
      rmse = rmse,
      mae = mae,
      r_squared = r_squared,
      no_data_reason = no_data_reason
    ))
  }
}


# print plots

# full battery of plots
for (my_audebert_reg in audebert_regs) {
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(agc_plot_list[[my_audebert_reg]], ncol = 2, axes = 'collect', axis_titles = 'collect') +
    plot_annotation(title = my_audebert_reg)
  suppressWarnings(print(combined_plot))
}

# panel plot with only "ALL" audebert regions
agc_plot_list_all_reg <- list()
for (my_af_cat in af_cats) {
  reason <- agc_out_df |> filter(ecoregion == 'ALL', af_cat == my_af_cat) |> pull(no_data_reason)
  reason_suffix <- if (length(reason) > 0 && !is.na(reason[1])) paste0(' (', reason[1], ')') else ''
  base_title <- if (my_af_cat == 'ALL') 'All AF categories' else my_af_cat
  agc_plot_list_all_reg[[my_af_cat]] <- agc_plot_list[['ALL']][[my_af_cat]] +

}
agc_combined_plot_all_reg <- wrap_plots(agc_plot_list_all_reg, ncol = 2, axes = 'collect', axis_titles = 'collect')
suppressWarnings(print(agc_combined_plot_all_reg))
ggsave(here("output", "figures", "agc_cr_fit_by_af_cat_all_reg_panel.png"), plot = agc_combined_plot_all_reg, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```


AGC vs. age panel by ecoregion (all AF categories pooled), with delta-method 95% confidence bands.
```{r agc-er-panel, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 7}
# Panel: AGC vs age by ecoregion — single colour, 95% CI band on curve (delta method)

# Helper: re-fit Chapman-Richards for a data subset and return CI band tibble.
# Returns NULL if data is insufficient or fit fails.
fit_cr_bands <- function(my_df, dep_var, age_seq = seq(0, 100, by = 0.5),
                         alpha_level = 0.05, weighted = TRUE) {
  my_df <- my_df |> filter(!is.na(.data[[dep_var]]), !is.na(age))
  if (nrow(my_df) < 15) return(NULL)
  # Age-weighted to match the AGC table fits; SOC fits are unweighted
  w <- if (weighted) my_df$age else rep(1, nrow(my_df))

  y_ref     <- as.numeric(quantile(my_df[[dep_var]], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE))
  c_start   <- 2
  b_start   <- 1 / max(median(my_df$age, na.rm = TRUE), 1e-6)
  t95_lower <- 5; t95_upper <- 80
  t95_start <- -log(1 - 0.95^(1 / c_start)) / max(b_start, 1e-8)
  alpha_start <- qlogis(min(max(quantile(my_df[[dep_var]], 0.95) / y_ref, 1e-6), 0.99))

  start_grid <- expand.grid(
    alpha = seq(qlogis(0.005), qlogis(0.995), length.out = 15),
    t95   = seq(t95_lower, t95_upper, length.out = 7),
    c     = seq(1.5, 3, length.out = 5)
  )
  cr_form <- as.formula(paste0(
    dep_var, " ~ (y_ref * plogis(alpha)) *",
    " (1 - exp(-(-log(1 - 0.95^(1/c)) / t95) * age))^c"
  ))

  cr_nls2 <- try(nls2(cr_form, data = my_df, start = start_grid,
    weights = w, algorithm = "brute-force",
    control = nls.control(maxiter = 50, warnOnly = TRUE)), silent = TRUE)

  best <- if (!inherits(cr_nls2, "try-error")) as.list(coef(cr_nls2)) else
    list(alpha = alpha_start, t95 = t95_start, c = c_start)

  cr_fit <- try(nlsLM(cr_form, data = my_df, start = best,
    weights = w,
    lower = c(alpha = -20, t95 = t95_lower, c = 1.5),
    upper = c(alpha =  20, t95 = t95_upper, c = 3),
    control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 500, ftol = 1e-10, ptol = 1e-10)),
    silent = TRUE)

  if (inherits(cr_fit, "try-error")) return(NULL)

  r_sq <- 1 - sum((my_df[[dep_var]] - predict(cr_fit))^2) /
              sum((my_df[[dep_var]] - mean(my_df[[dep_var]]))^2)
  if (r_sq < 0) return(NULL)

  params <- coef(cr_fit)
  V      <- vcov(cr_fit)
  t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha_level / 2, df = nrow(my_df) - length(params))

  pred_fn <- function(par, age) {
    a_v <- y_ref * plogis(par[["alpha"]])
    b_v <- -log(1 - 0.95^(1 / par[["c"]])) / par[["t95"]]
    a_v * (1 - exp(-b_v * age))^par[["c"]]
  }

  # Numerical Jacobian via central differences
  h   <- sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) * abs(params) + 1e-8
  jac <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(age_seq), ncol = length(params))
  for (j in seq_along(params)) {
    pp <- params; pp[j] <- params[j] + h[j]
    pm <- params; pm[j] <- params[j] - h[j]
    jac[, j] <- (pred_fn(pp, age_seq) - pred_fn(pm, age_seq)) / (2 * h[j])
  }

  se <- sqrt(pmax(0, rowSums((jac %*% V) * jac)))
  y  <- pred_fn(params, age_seq)
  tibble(age = age_seq, fit = y, lwr = y - t_crit * se, upr = y + t_crit * se)
}

desired_order_er <- c("Tropical/subtropical wet", "Tropical/subtropical dry",
                      "Temperate wet", "Temperate dry", "Boreal/polar", "ALL")

agc_panel_list <- list()

for (my_audebert_reg in desired_order_er) {
  my_data <- if (my_audebert_reg == "ALL") agc_df else
    agc_df |> filter(ecoregion == my_audebert_reg)

  bands        <- fit_cr_bands(my_data, dep_var = "c_t_ha")
  scatter      <- my_data |> filter(!is.na(c_t_ha), !is.na(age))
  panel_title  <- if (my_audebert_reg == "ALL") "All ecoregions" else my_audebert_reg

  agc_panel_list[[my_audebert_reg]] <- ggplot(scatter, aes(x = age, y = c_t_ha)) +
    { if (!is.null(bands))
        geom_ribbon(data = bands, aes(x = age, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
                    inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "deepskyblue4", alpha = 0.2) } +
    geom_point(size = 0.85, alpha = 0.5, shape = 16, stroke = 0, color = "grey40") +
    { if (!is.null(bands))
        geom_line(data = bands, aes(x = age, y = fit),
                  color = "deepskyblue4", linewidth = 0.85, inherit.aes = FALSE) } +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 140), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    xlim(0, 100) +
    labs(title = panel_title, x = "Age (years)", y = expression(AGC~(Mg~ha^{-1}))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(plot.title       = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
          axis.title       = element_text(size = 8),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

agc_er_panel <- wrap_plots(agc_panel_list, ncol = 2, axes = "collect", axis_titles = "collect")
suppressWarnings(print(agc_er_panel))

       plot = agc_er_panel, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

Write the AGC C-R fit tables: all region x AF category combinations, and a filtered version with successful fits only (used by notebooks 08 and 10). Each table has two header rows: the fitted-curve columns, and the observed mean annual change rate for the same partition, computed directly from the plot-level change rates in `agc_change_df` (`c_t_ha_yr`; mean, SE, and t-based 95% CI). Downstream readers use `startRow = 2`.
```{r agc-fit-tables}
# Helper: write a data frame to Excel with academic table formatting: an
# optional row of merged group headers (header_groups = named column counts;
# "" = no label), bold column header with borders, bottom border after the
# last row. Header and cell text may contain line breaks ("\n"): text wraps,
# column widths follow the longest line and row heights the number of lines.
write_pub_table <- function(df, file_path, header_groups = NULL) {
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb, "Sheet1")
  n_cols <- ncol(df)
  n_rows <- nrow(df)
  head_row <- if (is.null(header_groups)) 1 else 2
  line_h <- 15  # points per line (Calibri 11)

  if (!is.null(header_groups)) {
    stopifnot(sum(header_groups) == n_cols)
    group_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center",
                               border = "top", borderStyle = "medium")
    addStyle(wb, "Sheet1", group_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:n_cols, gridExpand = TRUE)
    underline_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center",
                                   valign = "bottom", wrapText = TRUE,
                                   border = c("top", "bottom"),
                                   borderStyle = c("medium", "thin"))
    start_col <- 1
    for (i in seq_along(header_groups)) {
      cols <- start_col:(start_col + header_groups[[i]] - 1)
      if (nzchar(names(header_groups)[i])) {
        writeData(wb, "Sheet1", names(header_groups)[i], startRow = 1, startCol = start_col)
        if (length(cols) > 1) mergeCells(wb, "Sheet1", cols = cols, rows = 1)
        addStyle(wb, "Sheet1", underline_style, rows = 1, cols = cols, gridExpand = TRUE)
      }
      start_col <- start_col + header_groups[[i]]
    }
    group_lines <- max(lengths(strsplit(names(header_groups), "\n")))
    setRowHeights(wb, "Sheet1", rows = 1, heights = group_lines * line_h)
  }

  writeData(wb, "Sheet1", df, startRow = head_row, startCol = 1, na.string = "")
  header_style <- createStyle(
    textDecoration = "bold", valign = "bottom", wrapText = TRUE,
    border        = if (is.null(header_groups)) c("top", "bottom") else "bottom",
    borderStyle   = "medium"
  )
  addStyle(wb, "Sheet1", header_style, rows = head_row, cols = 1:n_cols, gridExpand = TRUE)

  data_rows <- head_row + seq_len(n_rows)
  addStyle(wb, "Sheet1", createStyle(valign = "top", wrapText = TRUE),
           rows = data_rows, cols = 1:n_cols, gridExpand = TRUE)
  bottom_style <- createStyle(border = "bottom", borderStyle = "medium")
  addStyle(wb, "Sheet1", bottom_style, rows = n_rows + head_row, cols = 1:n_cols,
           gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)

  # Column width: longest header line (bold, ~10% wider) or longest value
  disp_nchar <- function(x) {
    x <- x[!is.na(x)]
    if (!length(x)) return(0)
    if (is.numeric(x)) x <- format(x, trim = TRUE, drop0trailing = TRUE)
    max(nchar(unlist(strsplit(as.character(x), "\n"))))
  }
  hdr_lines <- strsplit(names(df), "\n")
  hdr_w <- vapply(hdr_lines, \(l) max(nchar(l)), 0) * 1.1
  dat_w <- vapply(df, disp_nchar, 0)
  setColWidths(wb, "Sheet1", cols = 1:n_cols, widths = ceiling(pmax(hdr_w, dat_w)) + 1.5)
  setRowHeights(wb, "Sheet1", rows = head_row, heights = max(lengths(hdr_lines)) * line_h)

  chr <- vapply(df, is.character, TRUE)
  cell_lines <- if (any(chr)) {
    do.call(pmax, lapply(df[chr], \(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 1L, lengths(strsplit(x, "\n")))))
  } else rep(1L, n_rows)
  multi <- which(cell_lines > 1)
  if (length(multi)) setRowHeights(wb, "Sheet1", rows = data_rows[multi], heights = cell_lines[multi] * line_h)

  ok <- saveWorkbook(wb, file_path, overwrite = TRUE, returnValue = TRUE)
  if (!isTRUE(ok)) stop("Could not write ", file_path, " (is it open in Excel?)")
}

# Observed annual change rate for one region x AF category partition, using
# the same partition definitions as the fits ("ALL" region = all rows,
# including those without a region; combined regions expand via combined_regs)
obs_rate_summary <- function(change_df, region, af_cat_val) {
  d <- change_df
  if (region != "ALL") {
    reg_vals <- if (!is.null(combined_regs[[region]])) combined_regs[[region]] else region
    d <- d[d$ecoregion %in% reg_vals, ]
  }
  if (af_cat_val != "ALL") d <- d[d$af_cat %in% af_cat_val, ]
  x <- d$c_t_ha_yr[!is.na(d$c_t_ha_yr)]
  n <- length(x)
  m <- if (n > 0) mean(x) else NA_real_
  se <- if (n > 1) sd(x) / sqrt(n) else NA_real_
  t_crit <- if (n > 1) qt(0.975, df = n - 1) else NA_real_
  tibble(obs_n = n, obs_mean = m, obs_se = se,
         obs_ci_lwr = m - t_crit * se, obs_ci_upr = m + t_crit * se)
}

# Format and write the full and filtered C-R tables for one pool
write_cr_tables <- function(out_df, change_df, curve_header, file_stem) {
  region_levels <- c("Tropical/subtropical wet", "Tropical/subtropical dry",
                     "Tropical/subtropical all", "Temperate wet", "Temperate dry",
                     "Temperate all", "Boreal/polar", "ALL")
  obs_df <- out_df |>
    distinct(ecoregion, af_cat) |>
    mutate(obs = map2(ecoregion, af_cat, \(r, k) obs_rate_summary(change_df, r, k))) |>
    unnest(obs)

  tbl <- out_df |>
    left_join(obs_df, by = c("ecoregion", "af_cat")) |>
    mutate(ecoregion = factor(ecoregion, levels = region_levels)) |>
    arrange(ecoregion) |>
    mutate(
      ecoregion = if_else(as.character(ecoregion) == "ALL", "All ecoregions", as.character(ecoregion)),
      af_cat = if_else(af_cat == "ALL", "All AF categories", af_cat)
    ) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
    # Short display labels keep the table narrow (08 and 10 restore the full ones)
    mutate(ecoregion = sub("^Tropical/subtropical", "(Sub)tropical", ecoregion),
           af_cat = if_else(af_cat == "All AF categories", "All cats.", af_cat),
           no_data_reason = if_else(no_data_reason %in% "Insufficient data", "Insuff. data", no_data_reason))

  fmt <- function(d, include_reason) {
    d |>
      dplyr::select('Region' = ecoregion,
                    'AF\ncategory' = af_cat,
                    n,
                    'a (Stock at\nmaturity,\nMg C ha-1)' = asymptotic_max_a,
                    'a 95% CI\nlower' = a_ci_lwr,
                    'a 95% CI\nupper' = a_ci_upr,
                    'b\n(Growth)' = growth_rate_b,
                    'c\n(Shape)' = curve_shape_c,
                    'Age at\nmaturity\n(yr)' = age_90_pct,
                    'Growth rate\n(Mg C\nha-1 yr-1)' = avg_growth_rate_to_90,
                    'Growth rate\n95% CI\nlower' = growth_rate_ci_lwr,
                    'Growth rate\n95% CI\nupper' = growth_rate_ci_upr,
                    'RMSE\n(Mg C\nha-1)' = rmse,
                    'R²' = r_squared,
                    any_of(if (include_reason) c('Reason' = "no_data_reason")),
                    'n\n(rates)' = obs_n,
                    'Mean\n(Mg C\nha-1 yr-1)' = obs_mean,
                    'SE' = obs_se,
                    '95% CI\nlower' = obs_ci_lwr,
                    '95% CI\nupper' = obs_ci_upr)
  }
  groups <- function(include_reason) {
    setNames(c(2, 12 + include_reason, 5),
             c("", curve_header, "Observed annual change rate\n(mean of plot-level rates)"))
  }

  # Full table omits category x region combinations with no stock and no rate data
  write_pub_table(fmt(filter(tbl, n > 0 | obs_n > 0), TRUE), here("output", "tables", paste0(file_stem, ".xlsx")),
                  header_groups = groups(TRUE))
  write_pub_table(fmt(filter(tbl, !is.na(rmse)), FALSE),
                  here("output", "tables", paste0(file_stem, "_filtered.xlsx")),
                  header_groups = groups(FALSE))
}

write_cr_tables(agc_out_df, agc_change_df,
                curve_header = "Chapman-Richards curve fit (AGC stock vs. stand age)",
                file_stem = "agc_cr_fit_table")
```


Fit C-R curves of the SOC stock difference between agroforestry and control plots (`c_t_ha_delta`) vs. age for each ecoregion x AF category combination (asymptote reference = 0.95 quantile of values in the partition; unweighted fits), with bootstrap CIs for `a` and growth rate.
```{r soc-fits, fig.width=7, fig.height=7}
set.seed(6352)
c_data_name <- 'soc'
dep_var_name <- 'c_t_ha_delta'
cont_var <- "age"

audebert_regs <- get(paste0(c_data_name, '_df')) %>%
  pull(ecoregion) %>% unique()
audebert_regs <- audebert_regs[!is.na(audebert_regs)]
audebert_regs <- c(audebert_regs, "ALL", "Tropical/subtropical all", "Temperate all")

# Map combined region labels to the underlying ecoregion values
combined_regs <- list(
  "Tropical/subtropical all" = c("Tropical/subtropical wet", "Tropical/subtropical dry"),
  "Temperate all"            = c("Temperate wet", "Temperate dry")
)

global_age_max <- get(paste0(c_data_name, '_df')) %>%
  pull(.data[[cont_var]]) %>% max(na.rm = TRUE)

soc_plot_list <- list()
soc_out_df <- tibble()

for (my_audebert_reg in audebert_regs) {
  for (my_af_cat in af_cats) {
    
    my_comb_lab <- paste0(my_audebert_reg, '; ', my_af_cat)
    message(my_comb_lab)
    
    # For combined regions, expand to constituent region values
    reg_vals <- if (!is.null(combined_regs[[my_audebert_reg]])) combined_regs[[my_audebert_reg]] else my_audebert_reg
    
    if (my_audebert_reg == 'ALL' && my_af_cat == 'ALL') {
      my_c_df <- get(paste0(c_data_name, '_df')) %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[dep_var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[cont_var]]))
    } else if (my_audebert_reg == 'ALL') {
      my_c_df <- get(paste0(c_data_name, '_df')) %>%
        filter(af_cat == my_af_cat) %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[dep_var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[cont_var]]))
    } else if (my_af_cat == 'ALL') {
      my_c_df <- get(paste0(c_data_name, '_df')) %>%
        filter(ecoregion %in% reg_vals) %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[dep_var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[cont_var]]))
    } else {
      my_c_df <- get(paste0(c_data_name, '_df')) %>%
        filter(ecoregion %in% reg_vals) %>%
        filter(af_cat == my_af_cat) %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[dep_var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[cont_var]]))
    }
    
    my_n <- nrow(my_c_df)
    
    insuff_dat <- FALSE
    if (my_n < 15) insuff_dat <- TRUE
    
    no_data_reason <- NA_character_
    if (insuff_dat) no_data_reason <- "Insufficient data"
    
    fit_ok <- FALSE
    
    if (!insuff_dat) {
      
      # asymptote cap at 0.95 quantile (unlike AGC, the SOC-delta fit is unweighted)
      q_cap <- 0.95
      y_max_obs <- max(my_c_df[[dep_var_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
      y_q <- quantile(my_c_df[[dep_var_name]], q_cap, na.rm = TRUE)
      y_ref <- as.numeric(y_q)
      
      # starting values based on capped reference
      a_start <- y_q
      a_frac_start <- min(max(as.numeric(a_start / y_ref), 1e-6), 0.99)
      alpha_start <- qlogis(a_frac_start)
      
      my_age_max <- max(my_c_df$age, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      t95_lower <- 5
      t95_upper <- 80
      
      c_start <- 2
      b_start <- 1 / max(median(my_c_df$age, na.rm = TRUE), 1e-6)
      t95_start <- -log(1 - 0.95^(1 / c_start)) / max(b_start, 1e-8)
      
      t95_grid <- seq(t95_lower, t95_upper, length.out = 7)
      
      start_grid <- expand.grid(
        alpha = seq(qlogis(0.005), qlogis(0.995), length.out = 15),
        t95   = t95_grid,
        c     = seq(1.5, 3, length.out = 5)
      )
      
      # Rename response to a fixed name — avoids formula environment scoping
      # issues with nlsLM when the column name is constructed programmatically
      my_c_df_nls <- my_c_df
      my_c_df_nls$y_resp <- my_c_df_nls[[dep_var_name]]

      cr_formula <- y_resp ~ (y_ref * plogis(alpha)) *
        (1 - exp(-(-log(1 - 0.95^(1/c)) / t95) * age))^c

      cr_nls2 <- try(
        nls2(
          cr_formula,
          data = my_c_df_nls,
          start = start_grid,
          algorithm = "brute-force",
          control = nls.control(maxiter = 50, warnOnly = TRUE)
        ),
        silent = TRUE
      )
      
      best_start <- if (!inherits(cr_nls2, "try-error")) {
        as.list(coef(cr_nls2))
      } else {
        list(alpha = alpha_start, t95 = t95_start, c = c_start)
      }

      cr_fit <- try(
        nlsLM(
          cr_formula,
          data    = my_c_df_nls,
          start   = best_start,
          lower   = c(alpha = -20, t95 = t95_lower, c = 1.5),
          upper   = c(alpha =  20, t95 = t95_upper, c = 3),
          control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 500, ftol = 1e-10, ptol = 1e-10)
        ),
        silent = TRUE
      )
      
      if (!inherits(cr_fit, "try-error")) {
        fit_ok <- TRUE
      } else {
        message("fit failed: ", attr(cr_fit, "condition")$message)
        no_data_reason <- "Fit failed"
      }
    }
    
    if (fit_ok) {
      
      b_from_t95 <- function(t95, c) {
        -log(1 - 0.95^(1 / c)) / t95
      }
      
      co <- coef(cr_fit)
      a_hat <- y_ref * plogis(co["alpha"])
      b_hat <- b_from_t95(co["t95"], co["c"])
      c_hat <- co["c"]
      
      age_grid <- tibble(!!cont_var := 0:global_age_max) %>%
        mutate(chapman_curve = as.numeric(predict(cr_fit, newdata = .)))
      
      ageinfl <- (1 / b_hat) * log(c_hat)
      
      age_at_frac <- function(frac, a, b, c) {
        -log(1 - frac^(1 / c)) / b
      }
      
      mai_to_frac <- function(frac, a, b, c) {
        t_x <- age_at_frac(frac, a, b, c)
        (frac * a) / t_x
      }
      
      t90 <- age_at_frac(0.9, a_hat, b_hat, c_hat)
      mai90 <- mai_to_frac(0.9, a_hat, b_hat, c_hat)
      
      rmse <- sqrt(mean((my_c_df[[dep_var_name]] - predict(cr_fit))^2))
      mae <- mean(abs(my_c_df[[dep_var_name]] - predict(cr_fit)))
      ss_res <- sum((my_c_df[[dep_var_name]] - predict(cr_fit))^2)
      ss_tot <- sum((my_c_df[[dep_var_name]] - mean(my_c_df[[dep_var_name]]))^2)
      r_squared <- 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
      
      if (r_squared < 0) {
        fit_ok <- FALSE
        no_data_reason <- "Negative R\u00b2"
        a_hat <- NA; b_hat <- NA; c_hat <- NA
        ageinfl <- NA; t90 <- NA; mai90 <- NA
        rmse <- NA; mae <- NA; r_squared <- NA
      }
      
    } else {
      a_hat <- NA; b_hat <- NA; c_hat <- NA
      ageinfl <- NA; t90 <- NA; mai90 <- NA
      rmse <- NA; mae <- NA; r_squared <- NA
    }
    
    # Bootstrap 95% CI for a (stock at maturity) and growth rate (MAI to 90% maturity)
    # NB: SOC-delta fit uses the renamed "y_resp" column and is unweighted.
    if (fit_ok) {
      ci_res <- fit_cr_param_ci(
        my_df = my_c_df_nls, dep_var = "y_resp",
        warm_start = as.list(coef(cr_fit)), weight_var = NULL, B = 300
      )
      a_ci_lwr <- ci_res$a_lwr;        a_ci_upr <- ci_res$a_upr
      growth_ci_lwr <- ci_res$growth_lwr; growth_ci_upr <- ci_res$growth_upr
      boot_n_ok <- ci_res$n_ok
    } else {
      a_ci_lwr <- NA; a_ci_upr <- NA
      growth_ci_lwr <- NA; growth_ci_upr <- NA
      boot_n_ok <- NA
    }
    
    plot_obj <- ggplot(my_c_df, aes(x = !!sym(cont_var), y = !!sym(dep_var_name))) +
      geom_point(size = .5, alpha = .75, fill = 'black', stroke = 0) +
      { if (fit_ok) geom_line(data = age_grid, aes(y = chapman_curve), color = "deepskyblue4", linewidth = .75) } +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-45, 60), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
      xlim(0, 100) + # setting age limit for plot to 100y for better viz, even though there are a few outliers.  
      labs(title = my_af_cat, x = "Age", y = expression(Delta~SOC~(Mg~ha^{-1}))) +
      { if (!fit_ok) labs(title = paste0(my_af_cat, ' (', no_data_reason, ')')) } +
      { if (fit_ok) annotate("label", x = 99, y = 55,
          label = paste0("a = ", round(a_hat, 2), "\nb = ", round(b_hat, 4), "\nc = ", round(c_hat, 2),
                         "\nRMSE = ", round(rmse, 2), "\nR\u00b2 = ", round(r_squared, 2)),
          hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 2.5,
          fill = alpha("white", 0.8), label.size = 0,
          label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines")) } +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
    
    soc_plot_list[[my_audebert_reg]][[my_af_cat]] <- plot_obj
    
    soc_out_df <- soc_out_df %>% bind_rows(tibble(
      ecoregion = my_audebert_reg,
      af_cat = my_af_cat,
      n = my_n,
      asymptotic_max_a = a_hat,
      a_ci_lwr = a_ci_lwr,
      a_ci_upr = a_ci_upr,
      growth_rate_b = b_hat,
      curve_shape_c = c_hat,
      age_max_growth = ageinfl,
      age_90_pct = t90,
      avg_growth_rate_to_90 = mai90,
      growth_rate_ci_lwr = growth_ci_lwr,
      growth_rate_ci_upr = growth_ci_upr,
      boot_n_ok = boot_n_ok,
      rmse = rmse,
      mae = mae,
      r_squared = r_squared,
      no_data_reason = no_data_reason
    ))
  }
}


# print plots

# full battery of plots

  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(soc_plot_list[[my_audebert_reg]], ncol = 2, axes = 'collect', axis_titles = 'collect') +
    plot_annotation(title = my_audebert_reg)
  suppressWarnings(print(combined_plot))
}
```

SOC (delta) vs. age panel by ecoregion (all AF categories pooled), with delta-method 95% confidence bands.
```{r soc-er-panel, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 7}
# Panel: SOC delta vs age by ecoregion — single colour, 95% CI band on curve (delta method)
# Reuses fit_cr_bands() defined in the AGC chunk above.

desired_order_er_soc <- c("Tropical/subtropical wet", "Tropical/subtropical dry",
                          "Temperate wet", "Temperate dry", "Boreal/polar", "ALL")

soc_panel_list <- list()

for (my_audebert_reg in desired_order_er_soc) {
  my_data <- if (my_audebert_reg == "ALL") soc_df else
    soc_df |> filter(ecoregion == my_audebert_reg)

  bands       <- fit_cr_bands(my_data, dep_var = "c_t_ha_delta", weighted = FALSE)
  scatter     <- my_data |> filter(!is.na(c_t_ha_delta), !is.na(age))
  panel_title <- if (my_audebert_reg == "ALL") "All ecoregions" else my_audebert_reg

  soc_panel_list[[my_audebert_reg]] <- ggplot(scatter, aes(x = age, y = c_t_ha_delta)) +
    { if (!is.null(bands))
        geom_ribbon(data = bands, aes(x = age, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
                    inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "deepskyblue4", alpha = 0.2) } +
    geom_point(size = 0.85, alpha = 0.5, shape = 16, stroke = 0, color = "grey40") +
    { if (!is.null(bands))
        geom_line(data = bands, aes(x = age, y = fit),
                  color = "deepskyblue4", linewidth = 0.85, inherit.aes = FALSE) } +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-45, 60), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    xlim(0, 100) +
    labs(title = panel_title, x = "Age (years)", y = expression(Delta~SOC~(Mg~ha^{-1}))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(plot.title       = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
          axis.title       = element_text(size = 8),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

soc_er_panel <- wrap_plots(soc_panel_list, ncol = 2, axes = "collect", axis_titles = "collect")
suppressWarnings(print(soc_er_panel))
ggsave(here("output", "figures", "soc_delta_cr_fit_by_er_all_af_cat_panel.png"),
       plot = soc_er_panel, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```


Alternative AGC and SOC ecoregion panels with case-bootstrap (rather than delta-method) 95% confidence bands.
```{r bootstrap-panels, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 7}
set.seed(2094)
# Case-bootstrap 95% CI panels — AGC and SOC
# Kept separate from the delta-method chunks above so both versions are reproducible.
#
# Strategy: fit original data with full brute-force start to get reliable coefficients,
# then refit B resamples using those coefficients as a warm start (no brute-force),
# and take 2.5/97.5 percentiles of the curve envelope.
# y_ref (0.95-quantile cap) is recomputed from each resample so the parameterisation
# remains internally consistent.

fit_cr_bands_boot <- function(my_df, dep_var, B = 500,
                               age_seq   = seq(0, 100, by = 0.5),
                               alpha_level = 0.05, weighted = TRUE) {
  my_df <- my_df |> filter(!is.na(.data[[dep_var]]), !is.na(age))
  if (nrow(my_df) < 15) return(NULL)
  # Age-weighted to match the AGC table fits; SOC fits are unweighted
  w <- if (weighted) my_df$age else rep(1, nrow(my_df))

  t95_lower <- 5; t95_upper <- 80
  cr_form   <- as.formula(paste0(
    dep_var, " ~ (y_ref * plogis(alpha)) *",
    " (1 - exp(-(-log(1 - 0.95^(1/c)) / t95) * age))^c"
  ))

  # ── Original fit (brute-force start for reliability) ──────────────────
  y_ref       <- as.numeric(quantile(my_df[[dep_var]], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE))
  c_start     <- 2
  b_start     <- 1 / max(median(my_df$age, na.rm = TRUE), 1e-6)
  t95_start   <- -log(1 - 0.95^(1 / c_start)) / max(b_start, 1e-8)
  alpha_start <- qlogis(min(max(quantile(my_df[[dep_var]], 0.95) / y_ref, 1e-6), 0.99))

  start_grid <- expand.grid(
    alpha = seq(qlogis(0.005), qlogis(0.995), length.out = 15),
    t95   = seq(t95_lower, t95_upper, length.out = 7),
    c     = seq(1.5, 3, length.out = 5)
  )
  cr_nls2 <- try(nls2(cr_form, data = my_df, start = start_grid,
    weights = w, algorithm = "brute-force",
    control = nls.control(maxiter = 50, warnOnly = TRUE)), silent = TRUE)

  best <- if (!inherits(cr_nls2, "try-error")) as.list(coef(cr_nls2)) else
    list(alpha = alpha_start, t95 = t95_start, c = c_start)

  cr_fit_orig <- try(nlsLM(cr_form, data = my_df, start = best,
    weights = w,
    lower = c(alpha = -20, t95 = t95_lower, c = 1.5),
    upper = c(alpha =  20, t95 = t95_upper, c = 3),
    control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 500, ftol = 1e-10, ptol = 1e-10)),
    silent = TRUE)

  if (inherits(cr_fit_orig, "try-error")) return(NULL)
  r_sq <- 1 - sum((my_df[[dep_var]] - predict(cr_fit_orig))^2) /
              sum((my_df[[dep_var]] - mean(my_df[[dep_var]]))^2)
  if (r_sq < 0) return(NULL)

  warm_start  <- as.list(coef(cr_fit_orig))
  y_ref_orig  <- as.numeric(quantile(my_df[[dep_var]], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE))

  # ── Bootstrap loop ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # y_ref is updated each iteration; formula looks it up from this environment
  boot_preds <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = B, ncol = length(age_seq))

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    resamp <- my_df[sample(nrow(my_df), nrow(my_df), replace = TRUE), ]
    y_ref  <- as.numeric(quantile(resamp[[dep_var]], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE))

    fit_b <- try(nlsLM(cr_form, data = resamp, start = warm_start,
      weights = if (weighted) resamp$age else rep(1, nrow(resamp)),
      lower = c(alpha = -20, t95 = t95_lower, c = 1.5),
      upper = c(alpha =  20, t95 = t95_upper, c = 3),
      control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 200, ftol = 1e-7, ptol = 1e-7)),
      silent = TRUE)

    if (inherits(fit_b, "try-error")) next

    co_b <- coef(fit_b)
    a_b  <- y_ref * plogis(co_b[["alpha"]])
    bv_b <- -log(1 - 0.95^(1 / co_b[["c"]])) / co_b[["t95"]]
    boot_preds[b, ] <- a_b * (1 - exp(-bv_b * age_seq))^co_b[["c"]]
  }

  ok <- rowSums(is.na(boot_preds)) == 0
  message(sprintf("  %d/%d bootstrap fits succeeded", sum(ok), B))
  if (sum(ok) < 50) return(NULL)

  # Central curve from original fit
  y_ref   <- y_ref_orig
  co_orig <- coef(cr_fit_orig)
  a_orig  <- y_ref * plogis(co_orig[["alpha"]])
  bv_orig <- -log(1 - 0.95^(1 / co_orig[["c"]])) / co_orig[["t95"]]
  y_fit   <- a_orig * (1 - exp(-bv_orig * age_seq))^co_orig[["c"]]

  rmse <- sqrt(mean((my_df[[dep_var]] - predict(cr_fit_orig))^2))

  bp <- boot_preds[ok, , drop = FALSE]
  list(
    bands = tibble(
      age = age_seq,
      fit = y_fit,
      lwr = apply(bp, 2, quantile, probs = alpha_level / 2),
      upr = apply(bp, 2, quantile, probs = 1 - alpha_level / 2)
    ),
    stats = list(
      n    = nrow(my_df),
      a    = a_orig,
      b    = bv_orig,
      c    = co_orig[["c"]],
      rmse = rmse,
      r_sq = r_sq
    )
  )
}

desired_order_er <- c("Tropical/subtropical wet", "Tropical/subtropical dry",
                      "Temperate wet", "Temperate dry", "Boreal/polar", "ALL")

# ── AGC bootstrap panel ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
message("Fitting AGC bootstrap CIs...")
agc_panel_list_boot <- list()
for (my_audebert_reg in desired_order_er) {
  message(my_audebert_reg)
  my_data <- if (my_audebert_reg == "ALL") agc_df else
    agc_df |> filter(ecoregion == my_audebert_reg)

  result      <- fit_cr_bands_boot(my_data, dep_var = "c_t_ha")
  bands       <- result$bands
  stats       <- result$stats
  scatter     <- my_data |> filter(!is.na(c_t_ha), !is.na(age))
  panel_title <- if (my_audebert_reg == "ALL") "All ecoregions" else my_audebert_reg

  agc_panel_list_boot[[my_audebert_reg]] <- ggplot(scatter, aes(x = age, y = c_t_ha)) +
    { if (!is.null(bands))
        geom_ribbon(data = bands, aes(x = age, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
                    inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "deepskyblue4", alpha = 0.2) } +
    geom_point(size = 0.85, alpha = 0.5, shape = 16, stroke = 0, color = "grey40") +
    { if (!is.null(bands))
        geom_line(data = bands, aes(x = age, y = fit),
                  color = "deepskyblue4", linewidth = 0.85, inherit.aes = FALSE) } +
    { if (!is.null(stats))
        annotate("label", x = 99, y = 130,
          label = paste0("n = ", stats$n,
                         "\na = ", round(stats$a, 2),
                         "\nb = ", round(stats$b, 4),
                         "\nc = ", round(stats$c, 2),
                         "\nRMSE = ", round(stats$rmse, 2),
                         "\nR\u00b2 = ", round(stats$r_sq, 2)),
          hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 2.5,
          fill = alpha("white", 0.8), linewidth = 0,
          label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines")) } +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 140), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    xlim(0, 100) +
    labs(title = panel_title, x = "Age (years)", y = expression(AGC~(Mg~ha^{-1}))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(plot.title       = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
          axis.title       = element_text(size = 8),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

agc_er_panel_boot <- wrap_plots(agc_panel_list_boot, ncol = 2,
                                 axes = "collect", axis_titles = "collect")
suppressWarnings(print(agc_er_panel_boot))
ggsave(here("output", "figures", "agc_cr_fit_by_er_all_af_cat_panel_boot.png"),
       plot = agc_er_panel_boot, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 600, bg = "white")

# ── SOC bootstrap panel ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
message("Fitting SOC bootstrap CIs...")
soc_panel_list_boot <- list()
for (my_audebert_reg in desired_order_er) {
  message(my_audebert_reg)
  my_data <- if (my_audebert_reg == "ALL") soc_df else
    soc_df |> filter(ecoregion == my_audebert_reg)

  result      <- fit_cr_bands_boot(my_data, dep_var = "c_t_ha_delta", weighted = FALSE)
  bands       <- result$bands
  stats       <- result$stats
  scatter     <- my_data |> filter(!is.na(c_t_ha_delta), !is.na(age))
  panel_title <- if (my_audebert_reg == "ALL") "All ecoregions" else my_audebert_reg

  soc_panel_list_boot[[my_audebert_reg]] <- ggplot(scatter, aes(x = age, y = c_t_ha_delta)) +
    { if (!is.null(bands))
        geom_ribbon(data = bands, aes(x = age, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
                    inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "deepskyblue4", alpha = 0.2) } +
    geom_point(size = 0.85, alpha = 0.5, shape = 16, stroke = 0, color = "grey40") +
    { if (!is.null(bands))
        geom_line(data = bands, aes(x = age, y = fit),
                  color = "deepskyblue4", linewidth = 0.85, inherit.aes = FALSE) } +
    { if (!is.null(stats))
        annotate("label", x = 99, y = 55,
          label = paste0("n = ", stats$n,
                         "\na = ", round(stats$a, 2),
                         "\nb = ", round(stats$b, 4),
                         "\nc = ", round(stats$c, 2),
                         "\nRMSE = ", round(stats$rmse, 2),
                         "\nR\u00b2 = ", round(stats$r_sq, 2)),
          hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 2.5,
          fill = alpha("white", 0.8), linewidth = 0,
          label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines")) } +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-45, 60), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    xlim(0, 100) +
    labs(title = panel_title, x = "Age (years)", y = expression(Delta~SOC~(Mg~ha^{-1}))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(plot.title       = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
          axis.title       = element_text(size = 8),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

soc_er_panel_boot <- wrap_plots(soc_panel_list_boot, ncol = 2,

       plot = soc_er_panel_boot, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```
